content_law: Show two distinct people in a materially different present circumstance from the primary probe.
A durable earlier human choice must have changed a shared condition in a way that materially alters how the two people can occupy, use, reach, avoid, or depend on something now.
The present image must carry enough evidence to make the changed condition recoverable without a literal before/after comparison or explanatory text.
The people must remain specific and relationally necessary without repeating any primary cast, pose topology, prop set, architecture, camera arrangement, or signature motif.
Do not assert private knowledge, belief, memory, emotion, or intent.
Invent all unstated circumstances independently; no software/product/brand context.
output: one uninterrupted landscape artwork; no text, logo, border, presentation board, UI, diagram labels, or explanatory inset
